int_name: W LOUDON ST & N SYDENHAM ST

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk across a one-way side street. While sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the environment lacks active traffic control and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Parking-related sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the side street can hide pedestrians, especially children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street intersection

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking near the intersection.

result.summary: This residential street features continuous sidewalks and a curb ramp with tactile paving in the foreground, but lacks marked crossings. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked cars on both sides create potential sightline issues and may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Wide unmarked roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide residential street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable vehicle positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Center roadway extending into the distance

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked cars along both curbs can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the street along the curb

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and patching in the roadway surface can create uneven footing for pedestrians crossing outside of intersections.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly designate pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at corners to shorten the crossing distance and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential environment.

result.summary: The image depicts a typical residential street with row houses and a continuous sidewalk. While the environment is low-speed, it lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crossings, street lighting, and traffic calming measures.

hazards.description: There are no designated crossing points visible for pedestrians along this stretch of the roadway.

hazards.name: Absence of street lighting

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with continuous sidewalks but a complete absence of marked crossings or traffic control devices at the visible intersection. Parked vehicles along both curbs create significant visual obstructions, and the wide, unmarked roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds.
